_meta.description: Masculine mass/uncountable nouns with a colloquial partitive genitive in -у/-ю (Rozental §150), alongside the standard -а/-я genitive. Verified via pymorphy3's 'gen2' grammeme (distinct from the standard 'gent' form); lexemes where gen2 collapses onto gent (e.g. огонь, толк, картофель) are deliberately excluded. Used by NounCaseGenPartitiveHandler to corrupt the standard -а/-я genitive into the -у/-ю form outside genuine partitive contexts.
_meta.source: manual curation; Rozental grammar tradition (second/partitive genitive); pymorphy3 gen2 cross-check
